svg.title: Reported improvements sit apart from review limits
svg.desc: Keep reported improvements and independent-review limits equally visible across a hard divider. A large numerical claim must not hide the scope of its verification. Visual distinction: A firm source edge with incomplete outer brackets. The blank gutter marks the limit of review, not destruction or proof of absence.
